A test build of VideditBridge {version}. Edit videos by asking Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini, with your own API key ([how to get one](https://dev-henen.github.io/videditbridge/api-keys.html)). Every model comes with the app, so the download is large (about 1.5 GB) and nothing more downloads on first use.

## Install

**Windows:** download `VideditBridge-{version}-windows-x64-setup.exe` and run it. It installs for your user, without an administrator prompt. The app is not signed yet, so Windows may say "Windows protected your PC": choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

**macOS (Apple Silicon):** open `VideditBridge-{version}-macos-arm64.dmg` and drag VideditBridge to Applications. The app is not notarized yet, so the first time, right-click it in Applications and choose **Open**, then **Open** again (or allow it in System Settings, Privacy and Security, **Open Anyway**).

**Linux (x86_64):** download `VideditBridge-{version}-linux-x86_64.AppImage`, make it executable (`chmod +x VideditBridge-*.AppImage`) and run it. Video playback uses the system's VLC: install it first (Debian and Ubuntu: `sudo apt install vlc`).

## Report a problem

Open an issue at [github.com/dev-henen/videditbridge/issues](https://github.com/dev-henen/videditbridge/issues) with your system, what you did and what happened.
